label.en: Military Commissioner of the Nanhai Army
Commander of the Southern Capital Palace Guard
label.zh: 南京侍衛親軍都指揮使

label.en: Military Commissioner of the Zhangguo Army

units.zh: 耶律沙 耶律抹只 蕭幹附:討古 耶律善補 耶律海裏
units.en: Yelu Sha, Yelu Mozhi, Xiao Gan, appended biography Taogu, Yelu Shanbu, and Yelu Haili
units.literal: Yelu Sha, Yelu Mozhi, Xiao Gan with appendix: Taogu, Yelu Shanbu, Yelu Haili

units.zh: 耶律沙
units.en: Yelu Sha
units.literal: Yelu Sha

units.zh: 耶律沙，字安隱。
units.en: Yelu Sha, whose courtesy name was Anyin.
units.literal: Yelu Sha, courtesy name Anyin.

units.zh: 其先嘗相遙輦氏。
units.en: His family had once served as ministers to the Yaolian clan.
units.literal: His ancestors had once been ministers to the Yaolian clan.

units.zh: 應歷間，累官南府宰相。
units.en: During the Yingli era he rose through successive posts to become Chancellor of the Southern Office.
units.literal: During the Yingli reign, through repeated offices he reached Southern Chancellor.

units.zh: 景宗即位，總領南面邊事。
units.en: When Emperor Jingzong acceded, Sha was placed in overall charge of affairs along the southern frontier.
units.literal: When Emperor Jingzong took the throne, he took overall charge of southern frontier affairs.

units.zh: 保寧間，宋攻河東，沙將兵救之，有功，加守太保。
units.en: In the Baoning period, when the Song attacked Hedong, Sha led troops to its relief and distinguished himself; he was promoted to Acting Grand Guardian.
units.literal: During Baoning, Song attacked Hedong; Sha led troops to rescue it, had merit, and was promoted to Acting Grand Guardian.

units.zh: 乾亨初，宋復北侵，沙將兵由間道至白馬嶺，阻大澗遇敵。
units.en: Early in the Qianheng era, when the Song again pressed northward, Sha marched by a concealed route to White Horse Ridge, where a deep ravine brought him face to face with the enemy.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qianheng, Song again invaded north; Sha led troops by a hidden route to White Horse Ridge, blocked by a great ravine where he met the enemy.

units.zh: 沙與諸將欲待後軍至而戰，冀王敵烈、監軍耶律抹只等以為急擊之便，沙不能奪。
units.en: Sha and his fellow commanders wanted to hold action until the rear guard came up; the Prince of Ji, Dilie, the army supervisor Yelu Mozhi, and others argued for an immediate assault, and Sha could not prevail against them.
units.literal: Sha and the generals wished to wait until the rear army arrived before fighting; the Prince of Ji, Dilie, the army supervisor Yelu Mozhi, and others held that a swift attack would be advantageous, and Sha could not overrule them.

units.zh: 敵烈等以先鋒渡澗，未半，為宋人所擊，兵潰。
units.en: Dilie and his colleagues took the vanguard across the ravine, but before they were even halfway over the Song struck them and the force broke in rout.
units.literal: Dilie and the others led the vanguard across the ravine; before they were halfway over, they were struck by the Song and the army collapsed.

units.zh: 敵烈及其子蛙哥、沙之子德裏、令穩都敏、詳穩唐筈等五將俱沒。
units.en: Dilie, his son Wage, Sha's son Deli, the lingwen Dumin, and the xiangwen Tanghua—five generals in all—were killed.
units.literal: Dilie, his son Wage, Sha's son Deli, Lingwen Dumin, Xiangwen Tanghua, and five generals in all perished.

units.zh: 會北院大王耶律斜軫兵至，萬矢俱發，敵軍始退。
units.en: At that moment the Northern Chancellor Yelu Xiezhen arrived with his troops; when ten thousand arrows flew as one, the enemy at last drew back.
units.literal: Just then the Northern Chancellor Yelu Xiezhen's troops arrived; ten thousand arrows flew together, and the enemy army only then withdrew.

units.zh: 沙將趨太原，會漢駙馬都尉盧俊來奔，言太原已陷，遂勒兵還。
units.en: Sha was pressing toward Taiyuan when the Han Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant Lu Jun came over to his side and reported that Taiyuan had already fallen; Sha thereupon turned his army back.
units.literal: Sha was about to hurry to Taiyuan when the Han Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant Lu Jun came fleeing to him, saying Taiyuan had already fallen, and he thereupon reined in the army and returned.

units.zh: 宋乘銳侵燕，沙與戰於高梁河，稍卻；
units.en: The Song, emboldened by their momentum, thrust into Yan; Sha met them at the Gaoliang River and gave ground;
units.literal: The Song, riding their momentum, invaded Yan; Sha fought them at Gaoliang River and fell back slightly;

units.zh: 遇耶律休哥及斜軫等邀擊，敗宋軍。
units.en: but then Yelu Xiuge, Xiezhen, and others cut across their path and routed the Song army.
units.literal: he encountered Yelu Xiuge and Xiezhen and others intercepting and striking, and defeated the Song army.

units.zh: 宋主宵遁，至涿州，微服乘驢車，間道而走。
units.en: The Song emperor fled under cover of night; reaching Zhuozhou, he went in disguise in a donkey cart along back roads to safety.
units.literal: The Song ruler fled by night; reaching Zhuozhou, in plain dress he rode a donkey cart and escaped by byways.

units.zh: 上以功釋前過。
units.en: The emperor pardoned his earlier failures in light of this success.
units.literal: The emperor, for this merit, released his earlier fault.

units.zh: 是年，復從韓匡嗣伐宋，敗績，帝欲誅之，以皇后營救得免。
units.en: That same year he again joined Han Kuangsi in a campaign against the Song and met with defeat; the emperor meant to put him to death, but the empress pleaded for him and he was spared.
units.literal: That year he again followed Han Kuangsi in attacking Song, suffered defeat, and the emperor wished to execute him; through the empress's intercession he was spared.

units.zh: 睿智皇后稱制，召賜几杖，以優其老。
units.en: When the Sagacious Empress Dowager assumed the regency, she summoned him and granted him a folding stool and staff as marks of esteem for his advanced years.
units.literal: When the Sagacious Empress Dowager held the regency, she summoned him and bestowed a folding stool and staff to honor his age.

units.zh: 復從伐宋，敗劉廷讓、李敬源之軍，賜賚優渥。
units.en: He took the field once more against the Song, routed the forces of Liu Tingrang and Li Jingyuan, and received a generous grant of rewards.
units.literal: He again followed in attacking Song, defeated the armies of Liu Tingrang and Li Jingyuan, and received lavish rewards.

units.zh: 統和六年卒。
units.en: He died in the sixth year of the Tonghe reign.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Tonghe he died.

units.zh: 耶律抹只
units.en: Yelu Mozhi
units.literal: Yelu Mozhi

units.zh: 耶律抹只，字留隱，仲父隋國王之後。
units.en: Yelu Mozhi, whose courtesy name was Liuyin, was of the younger line of the King of Sui.
units.literal: Yelu Mozhi, courtesy name Liuyin, was of the younger line of the King of Sui.

units.zh: 初以皇族入侍。
units.en: He first entered palace service as a member of the imperial clan.
units.literal: At first he entered attendance by virtue of imperial clan status.

units.zh: 景宗即位，為林牙，以幹給稱。
units.en: When Emperor Jingzong acceded, he was made linya and won repute for resourceful service.
units.literal: When Emperor Jingzong took the throne, he became linya and was praised for resourceful service.

units.zh: 保寧間，遷樞密副使。
units.en: In the Baoning period he was promoted to vice privy commissioner.
units.literal: During Baoning he was transferred to vice privy commissioner.

units.zh: 乾亨元年春，宋攻河東，南府宰相耶律沙為都統，將兵往援，抹只臨其軍。
units.en: In the spring of the first year of Qianheng, when the Song attacked Hedong, Southern Chancellor Yelu Sha was made supreme commander and marched to its relief; Mozhi supervised the army.
units.literal: In spring of the first year of Qianheng, Song attacked Hedong; the Southern Chancellor Yelu Sha served as supreme commander, led troops to relieve it, and Mozhi supervised his army.

units.zh: 及白馬嶺之敗，僅以身免。
units.en: After the defeat at White Horse Ridge he barely escaped with his life.
units.literal: At the defeat at White Horse Ridge he barely escaped with his life.

units.zh: 宋乘銳攻燕，將奚兵翊休哥擊敗之。
units.en: The Song, emboldened by their momentum, thrust into Yan; Mozhi led Xi troops to assist Yelu Xiuge and routed them.
units.literal: The Song, riding their momentum, attacked Yan; leading Xi troops he assisted Xiuge and defeated them.

units.zh: 上以功釋前過。
units.en: The emperor pardoned his earlier failures in light of this success.
units.literal: The emperor, for this merit, released his earlier fault.

units.zh: 是年冬，從都統韓匡嗣伐宋，戰於滿城，為宋將所紿，諸軍奔潰；
units.en: That winter he followed Supreme Commander Han Kuangsi against the Song and fought at Mancheng; tricked by a Song commander, the armies broke in rout;
units.literal: That winter he followed the supreme commander Han Kuangsi in attacking Song and fought at Mancheng; deceived by a Song general, the armies broke in rout;

units.zh: 獨抹只部伍不亂，徐整旗鼓而歸。
units.en: only Mozhi’s unit held its formation, and he slowly reformed his banners and drums and withdrew in order.
units.literal: only Mozhi’s ranks did not fall into disorder, and he slowly reformed banners and drums and returned.

units.zh: 璽書褒諭，改南海軍節度使。
units.en: An imperial commendation arrived in seal script, and he was made Military Commissioner of the Nanhai Army.
units.literal: An imperial edict in seal script commended and instructed him, and he was transferred to Military Commissioner of the Nanhai Army.

units.zh: 乾亨二年，拜樞密副使。
units.en: In the second year of Qianheng he was appointed vice privy commissioner.
units.literal: In the second year of Qianheng he was appointed vice privy commissioner.

units.zh: 統和初，為東京留守。
units.en: Early in Tonghe he was made regent of the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tonghe he became regent of the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 宋將曹彬、米信等侵邊，抹只引兵至南京，先繕守禦備。
units.en: When the Song generals Cao Bin, Mi Xin, and others invaded the frontier, Mozhi marched to Nanjing and first strengthened the city’s defenses.
units.literal: When the Song generals Cao Bin, Mi Xin, and others invaded the frontier, Mozhi led troops to Nanjing and first repaired defenses and preparations.

units.zh: 及車駕臨幸，抹只與耶律休哥逆戰於涿之東，克之，遷開遠軍節度使。
units.en: When the emperor arrived on inspection, Mozhi and Yelu Xiuge gave battle east of Zhuo, carried the day, and Mozhi was transferred to Military Commissioner of Kaiyuan Army.
units.literal: When the imperial carriage arrived on inspection, Mozhi together with Yelu Xiuge met the enemy in battle east of Zhuo, took it, and was transferred to Military Commissioner of Kaiyuan Army.

units.zh: 故事，州民歲輸稅，鬥粟折錢五，抹只表請折錢六，部民便之。
units.en: By precedent the people of the commandery paid yearly taxes with each dou of grain valued at five cash; Mozhi memorialized to raise the rate to six cash, and the people welcomed the change.
units.literal: By precedent the commandery people paid yearly taxes with each dou of grain converted at five cash; Mozhi memorialized requesting conversion at six cash, and the people of the division found it convenient.

units.zh: 統和末卒。
units.en: He died late in the Tonghe reign.
units.literal: At the end of Tonghe he died.

units.zh: 蕭幹，小字項烈，字婆典，北府宰相敵魯之子。
units.en: Xiao Gan, whose childhood name was Xianglie and courtesy name Podian, was the son of the Northern Chancellor Diru.
units.literal: Xiao Gan, childhood name Xianglie, courtesy name Podian, son of the Northern Chancellor Diru.

units.zh: 性質直。
units.en: By nature he was forthright and plain-spoken.
units.literal: His nature was upright and plain.

units.zh: 初，察割之亂，其黨胡古只與幹善，使人召之。
units.en: Early in Chagai's rebellion, one of his partisans, Huguzhi, who was on friendly terms with Gan, sent envoys to summon him.
units.literal: Earlier, during Chagai's rebellion, his partisan Huguzhi was on good terms with Gan and sent someone to summon him.

units.zh: 幹曰：「吾豈能從逆臣！」
units.en: Gan replied, "How could I follow a traitor!"
units.literal: Gan said: "How could I follow a rebellious minister!"

units.zh: 縛其人送壽安王。
units.en: He bound the envoy and sent him to the Prince of Shou'an.
units.literal: He bound the man and sent him to the Prince of Shou'an.

units.zh: 賊平，上嘉其忠，拜群牧都林牙。
units.en: After the rebels were suppressed, the emperor commended his loyalty and appointed him Chief Forest Master of the Herds.
units.literal: When the rebels were pacified, the emperor praised his loyalty and appointed him Chief Forest Master of the Herds.

units.zh: 復以伐烏古功，遷北府宰相，改突呂不部節度使。
units.en: He was later promoted to Northern Chancellor for his service against the Wugu and made Military Commissioner of the Tulübu tribe.
units.literal: Again, for merit in attacking the Wugu, he was transferred to Northern Chancellor and made Military Commissioner of the Tulübu tribe.

units.zh: 乾亨初，宋伐河東，乘勝侵燕，詔幹拒之，戰於高梁河。
units.en: Early in Qianheng, when the Song attacked Hedong and, riding their victory, pressed into Yan, the court ordered Gan to hold them off; he gave battle at the Gaoliang River.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qianheng, Song attacked Hedong and, pressing their advantage, invaded Yan; the emperor ordered Gan to resist them, and he fought at Gaoliang River.

units.zh: 耶律沙退走，幹與耶律休哥等並力戰敗之，上手敕慰勞。
units.en: Yelu Sha had already fallen back, but Gan joined Yelu Xiuge and others in a combined assault that broke the enemy; the emperor sent a personal edict of commendation.
units.literal: Yelu Sha had retreated; Gan together with Yelu Xiuge and others joined forces, defeated the enemy, and the emperor sent a hand-written edict to console and reward them.

units.zh: 自是每征伐必參決軍事。
units.en: From then on he took part in every major military decision.
units.literal: From this time on, in every campaign he was sure to take part in deciding military affairs.

units.zh: 加政事令。
units.en: He was further appointed Chief of Political Affairs.
units.literal: He was given the additional title of Chief of Political Affairs.

units.zh: 二年，宋兵圍瓦橋，夜襲我營，幹及耶律勻骨戰卻之。
units.en: In the second year, when Song forces besieged Wagiao and raided the Liao camp by night, Gan and Yelu Jungu drove them back.
units.literal: In the second year, Song troops besieged Wagiao; at night they raided our camp, and Gan together with Yelu Jungu fought them off.

units.zh: 時皇后以父呼幹。
units.en: The empress addressed him as "Father."
units.literal: At the time the empress addressed Gan as "Father."

units.zh: 及後為皇太后稱制，幹數條奏便宜，多見聽用。
units.en: Later, when she ruled as empress dowager, Gan submitted one practical proposal after another, and many of his recommendations were adopted.
units.literal: Later, when she became empress dowager regent, Gan repeatedly submitted proposals of practical benefit, and many were adopted.

units.zh: 統和四年卒。
units.en: He died in the fourth year of the Tonghe reign.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Tonghe he died.

units.zh: 侄討古。
units.en: His nephew was Taogu.
units.literal: Nephew Taogu.

units.en: 〈Appended biography〉
units.literal: 〈Appended〉

units.zh: 討古
units.en: Taogu
units.literal: Taogu

units.zh: 討古，字括寧，性忠簡。
units.en: Taogu, whose courtesy name was Kuoning, was loyal and unassuming by nature.
units.literal: Taogu, courtesy name Kuoning, nature loyal and plain.

units.zh: 應歷初，始入侍。
units.en: At the opening of the Yingli era he first entered palace service.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yingli he first entered attendance.

units.zh: 會冀王敵烈、宣徽使海思謀反，討古與耶律阿列密告於上，上嘉其忠，詔尚樸謹公主。
units.en: When the Prince of Ji, Dilie, and the Xuanhui Commissioner Haisi conspired rebellion, Taogu and Yelu Alie reported them in secret; the emperor praised their loyalty and married Taogu to Princess Pujin.
units.literal: It happened that the Prince of Ji, Dilie, and the Xuanhui Commissioner Haisi plotted rebellion; Taogu together with Yelu Alie secretly reported to the emperor, who praised his loyalty and ordered him to marry Princess Pujin.

units.zh: 保寧末，為南京統軍使。
units.en: Late in Baoning he was made Commander-in-Chief of the Southern Capital.
units.literal: At the end of Baoning he became Southern Capital Commander-in-Chief.

units.zh: 乾亨初，宋侵燕，討古與北院大王奚底拒之，不克，軍潰。
units.en: Early in Qianheng, when the Song invaded Yan, Taogu and the Northern Chancellor Xidi tried to hold them off but failed and their army broke in rout.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qianheng, Song invaded Yan; Taogu together with the Northern Chancellor Xidi resisted them, could not overcome them, and the army collapsed.

units.zh: 討古等不敢復戰，退屯清河。
units.en: Taogu and his colleagues dared not give battle again and fell back to encamp at Qinghe.
units.literal: Taogu and the others did not dare fight again and withdrew to encamp at Qinghe.

units.zh: 帝聞其敗，遣使責之曰：「卿等不嚴偵候，用兵無法，遇敵即敗，奚以將為！」
units.en: When the emperor learned of the defeat, he sent an envoy to rebuke them: "You kept poor watch, handled your troops without discipline, and broke the moment you met the enemy—what sort of commanders are you!"
units.literal: The emperor heard of their defeat and sent an envoy to rebuke them, saying: "You did not keep strict watch, employed troops without method, and were defeated as soon as you met the enemy—how can you serve as generals!"

units.zh: 討古懼。
units.en: Taogu was terrified.
units.literal: Taogu was afraid.

units.zh: 頃之，援兵至，討古奮力以敗宋軍。
units.en: Before long reinforcements arrived, and Taogu fought with renewed vigor to rout the Song army.
units.literal: Before long reinforcements arrived; Taogu exerted himself with force and defeated the Song army.

units.zh: 上釋其罪，降為南京侍衛親軍都指揮使。
units.en: The emperor pardoned him but reduced him to Commander of the Southern Capital Palace Guard.
units.literal: The emperor released his guilt and demoted him to Commander of the Southern Capital Palace Guard.

units.zh: 四年卒。
units.en: He died in the fourth year of Qianheng.
units.literal: In the fourth year he died.

units.zh: 耶律善補
units.en: Yelu Shanbu
units.literal: Yelu Shanbu

units.zh: 耶律善補，字瑤升，孟父楚國王之後。
units.en: Yelu Shanbu, whose courtesy name was Yaosheng, was a descendant of the Mengfu line of the King of Chu.
units.literal: Yelu Shanbu, courtesy name Yaosheng, descendant of the Mengfu King of Chu.

units.zh: 純謹有才智。
units.en: He was conscientious, prudent, and gifted with ability.
units.literal: Pure, careful, and possessed of talent and wisdom.

units.zh: 景宗即位，授千牛衛大將軍，遷大同軍節度使。
units.en: When Emperor Jingzong came to the throne, he was made Grand General of the Thousand-Ox Guard and then Military Commissioner of the Datong Army.
units.literal: When Emperor Jingzong took the throne, he was appointed Grand General of the Thousand-Ox Guard and transferred to Military Commissioner of Datong Army.

units.zh: 及伐宋，韓匡嗣與耶律沙將兵由東路進，善補以南京統軍使由西路進。
units.en: In the campaign against the Song, Han Kuangsi and Yelu Sha advanced along the eastern route while Shanbu, as Commander-in-Chief of the Southern Capital, moved up the western route.
units.literal: When they attacked Song, Han Kuangsi and Yelu Sha led troops in by the eastern route; Shanbu as Southern Capital Commander-in-Chief advanced by the western route.

units.zh: 善補聞匡嗣失利，斂兵還。
units.en: When Shanbu learned that Kuangsi had been defeated, he drew his troops back.
units.literal: Shanbu heard that Kuangsi had suffered defeat and gathered in his troops and returned.

units.zh: 乾亨末，與宋軍戰於滿城，為伏兵所圍，斜軫救之獲免。
units.en: Late in Qianheng he fought the Song at Mancheng, was caught in an ambush, and was saved only when Xiezhen came to his relief.
units.literal: At the end of Qianheng he fought Song troops at Mancheng, was surrounded by ambush troops, and Xiezhen rescued him so he escaped harm.

units.zh: 以失備，大杖決之。
units.en: For his lack of preparedness he was sentenced to a severe beating.
units.literal: For lack of preparedness he was sentenced to heavy cudgeling.

units.zh: 統和初，為惕隱。
units.en: Early in Tonghe he was made tiyin.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tonghe he became tiyin.

units.zh: 會宋來侵，善補為都元帥逆之，不敢戰，故嶺西州郡多陷，罷惕隱。
units.en: When the Song invaded again, Shanbu went out as supreme commander to meet them but would not give battle; many districts west of the passes therefore fell, and he was dismissed from the office of tiyin.
units.literal: When Song came to invade, Shanbu as supreme commander went to meet them but did not dare fight; therefore many prefectures and districts west of the passes fell, and he was removed as tiyin.

units.zh: 以其叔安端有匡輔世宗功，上湣之，征善補為南府宰相，遷南院大王。
units.en: Because his uncle Anduan had helped secure Emperor Shizong's succession, the court showed him favor: Shanbu was recalled to serve as Southern Chancellor and promoted to Great King of the Southern Office.
units.literal: Because his uncle Anduan had the merit of supporting and assisting Emperor Shizong, the emperor pitied him and summoned Shanbu to be Southern Chancellor, transferring him to Great King of the Southern Office.

units.zh: 會再舉伐宋，欲攻魏府，召眾集議。
units.en: On a later campaign against the Song, when the court planned to strike Weizhou, he called the commanders together for counsel.
units.literal: When they again raised troops to attack Song and wished to assault Weizhou, he summoned the host to assemble for deliberation.

units.zh: 將士以魏城無備，皆言可攻。
units.en: The officers and men, seeing Weizhou undefended, all urged an assault.
units.literal: The officers and soldiers, because Weizhou was undefended, all said it could be attacked.

units.zh: 善補曰：「攻固易，然城大叵量，若克其城，士卒貪俘掠，勢必不可遏。
units.en: Shanbu said, "The assault would be easy enough, but the city is vast; if we took it, the men would gorge on captives and loot, and the rush would be impossible to hold in check.
units.literal: Shanbu said: "The attack is indeed easy, yet the city is large beyond measure; if we take it, the soldiers will be greedy for captives and plunder, and the momentum will surely be impossible to restrain.

units.zh: 且傍多巨鎮，各出援兵，內有重敵，何以當之？」
units.en: Besides, great fortified towns lie all around; each would send relief, and we would face powerful enemies on every side—how could we stand against them?"
units.literal: Moreover, nearby are many great strongholds; each will send relief troops—within we would have a heavy enemy; how could we withstand it?"

units.zh: 上乃止。
units.en: The emperor thereupon abandoned the plan.
units.literal: The emperor then stopped.

units.zh: 善補性懦，守靜。
units.en: By nature Shanbu was timid and preferred quiet.
units.literal: Shanbu's nature was timid; he kept to quietude.

units.zh: 凡征討，憚攻戰，急還，以故戰多不利。
units.en: On campaign he shrank from battle and withdrew at the first opportunity, and for this reason his engagements usually went badly.
units.literal: In every campaign he dreaded fighting, hurried back, and for this reason battles were often unfavorable.

units.zh: 年七十四卒。
units.en: He died at the age of seventy-four.
units.literal: At age seventy-four he died.

units.zh: 耶律海裏
units.en: Yelu Haili
units.literal: Yelu Haili

units.zh: 耶律海裏，字留隱，令穩拔裏得之長子。
units.en: Yelu Haili, whose courtesy name was Liuyin, was the eldest son of the lingwen Balede.
units.literal: Yelu Haili, courtesy name Liuyin, was the eldest son of the lingwen Balede.

units.zh: 察割之亂，其母的魯與焉。
units.en: During Chagai’s rebellion, his mother Dilu was involved.
units.literal: During Chagai’s rebellion, his mother Dilu took part in it.

units.zh: 遣人召海裏，海裏拒之。
units.en: Chagai’s faction sent envoys to summon Haili, but he refused.
units.literal: They sent someone to summon Haili, and Haili refused.

units.zh: 亂平，的魯以子故獲免。
units.en: After the rebellion was suppressed, Dilu was spared on account of her son.
units.literal: When the rebellion was pacified, Dilu was spared because of her son.

units.zh: 海裏儉素，不喜聲利，以射獵自娛。
units.en: Haili lived frugally and plainly, cared nothing for luxury or gain, and amused himself with archery and hunting.
units.literal: Haili was frugal and plain, disliked sound and profit, and amused himself with archery and hunting.

units.zh: 雖居閑，人敬之若貴官然。
units.en: Though he lived in retirement, people treated him with the respect due a high official.
units.literal: Although he lived in retirement, people respected him as if he were a noble official.

units.zh: 保寧初，拜彰國軍節度使，遷惕隱。
units.en: Early in Baoning he was made Military Commissioner of the Zhangguo Army and then promoted to tiyin.
units.literal: At the beginning of Baoning he was appointed Military Commissioner of the Zhangguo Army and transferred to tiyin.

units.zh: 秩滿，稱疾不仕。
units.en: When his term expired, he pleaded illness and declined further office.
units.literal: When his term expired, he pleaded illness and would not serve.

units.zh: 久之，復為南院大王。
units.en: After some years he was again made Great King of the Southern Office.
units.literal: After a long time he again became Great King of the Southern Office.

units.zh: 及曹彬、米信等來侵，海裏有卻敵功，賜資忠保義匡國功臣。
units.en: When Cao Bin, Mi Xin, and others invaded, Haili distinguished himself in repelling the enemy and was granted the title Meritous Minister Loyal in Purpose, Righteous in Conduct, and Stabilizing the State.
units.literal: When Cao Bin, Mi Xin, and others came to invade, Haili had merit in repelling the enemy and was granted the title Meritous Minister Loyal in Purpose, Righteous in Conduct, and Stabilizing the State.

units.zh: 帝屢親征，海裏在南院十餘年，鎮以寬靜，戶口增給，時議重之。
units.en: While the emperor repeatedly took the field in person, Haili spent more than ten years in the Southern Office, governing with lenience and calm; households and provisions increased, and contemporaries held him in high regard.
units.literal: The emperor repeatedly campaigned in person; Haili was in the Southern Office for more than ten years, governing with lenience and quiet, increasing registered households and provisions, and contemporary opinion esteemed him.

units.zh: 封漆水郡王，遷上京留守，薨。
units.en: He was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui, made regent of the Supreme Capital, and died in office.
units.literal: He was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui, transferred to regent of the Supreme Capital, and died.

units.zh: 詔以家貧，給葬具。
units.en: Because his household was poor, an edict granted funeral goods.
units.literal: An edict, because his household was poor, granted funeral goods.

units.zh: 論曰：當高梁、朔州之捷，偏裨之將如沙與抹只，既因休哥、斜軫類見其功，所謂失之東隅，收之桑榆。
units.en: The historian remarks: At the victories at Gaoliang and Shuozhou, subordinate commanders such as Sha and Mozhi, having through the likes of Xiuge and Xiezhen come to have their merit recognized, exemplify what is called losing at dawn yet making good the loss at dusk.
units.literal: The discussion says: At the victories at Gaoliang and Shuozhou, subordinate generals such as Sha and Mozhi, having through Xiuge, Xiezhen, and the like been seen for their merit, exemplify what is called losing at the eastern corner yet gaining at the mulberry and elm.

units.zh: 若蕭幹、海裏拒察割之招，討古告海思之變，則不止有戰功而已。
units.en: As for Xiao Gan and Haili, who refused Chagai's enticements, and Taogu, who exposed Haisi's conspiracy—their worth lay in more than battlefield success alone.
units.literal: As for Xiao Gan and Haili refusing Chagai's summons, and Taogu reporting Haisi's plot, they possessed more than battlefield merit alone.

units.zh: 其視善補畏懦，豈不優哉！
units.en: Set beside Shanbu's timid caution, were they not plainly the better men!
units.literal: Compared with Shanbu's timid cowardice, are they not superior!
